text:
ash: Heads up team 4 I'm in NYC next week and staying near Chelsea Market. Any quick sandwich spots or counter places for a 1pm lunch? Need something fast enough to eat between talks.

nina: Very jealous. Chelsea Market has Num Pang (great sandwiches), and Lobster Place for a quick seafood roll.

ash: Num Pang looks perfect. Any good vegetarian options nearby too?

tom: No.7 Sub (random hole-in-wall) does a wicked veggie banh mi. Also Bluestone Lane for salads/fast bowls if you want lighter.

jess: If you want something fun and quick, Shorty's makes decent tacos and usually fast. But for classic deli vibe, Friedman's Lunch is 5-7min walk and quick service.

ash: Cool. Poll: :sandwich: Num Pang, :leafy_green: Bluestone Lane, :taco: Shorty's, :bagel: Friedman's Lunch

nina: :sandwich:

tom: :bagel:

jess: :sandwich: (but friedman's if I'm late)

ash: Going to lock in Num Pang at 12:45 on Wed unless anyone objects. Is there outdoor seating?

nina: They have a counter and marketplace seating; can be crowded but turnover is fast.

tom: If you want quieter, head to the High Line north entrance and eat on a bench  nice view.

ops-bot: calendar: "Chelsea Market Lunch  Ash + Nina" created Wed 12:45-13:30 provisional. Attendees: ash, nina.

ash: Thanks! Quick address list in case you want to pin: ```Num Pang  169 10th Ave, New York, NY
Friedman's Lunch  75 9th Ave, New York, NY

jess: If anyone wants to join spur-of-the-moment, DM me and I'll try to save extra seats. See ya!
